headline: FAA Launches AI Air Traffic Control System
captionCards: Aims to enhance safety and efficiency in air travel
instagramCaption:
AI takes the skies in air traffic control.
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has launched an AI-based air traffic control system. Meanwhile, Sean Duffy is redirecting rail funds. This move aims to enhance safety and efficiency in managing air traffic. Why it matters: It could revolutionize how air travel is managed.
